timing.statement: This amendment was authored after the single authorized attempt failed closed and before any validator correction or correction run. Attempt 1 executed retrieval internally but produced no aggregate, winner, result object, emitted result, written result, or operator-visible comparative metric.

failureFinding.oldValidationSemantics: Require the exact query byte sequence to occur exactly once anywhere in the complete model-facing frame.
failureFinding.defect: The validator confused the single structural TASK QUERY field with legitimate literal query bytes in current sources, event titles, or event bodies.

amendment001PromiseAudit.promisedFailureRule: Any binding, reconstruction, mutation, renderer, method, or safety mismatch aborts before either retrieval method and writes no result.
amendment001PromiseAudit.reason: The affected frame validator depended on post-ranking selected events and ran after all neutral observations and the first safety case's Qarinah, admission-filtered-BM25, and raw-BM25 rankings.
amendment001PromiseAudit.remediation: Amendment 002 requires a deterministic all-frozen-frame preflight that completes before retrieval modules are loaded or any ranking method is called.

supersedesOnly: The base/Amendment-001 interpretation that the exact query byte sequence must occur exactly once across the complete rendered frame.

The Amendment-001 failure rule's implementation assumption that data-dependent renderer, method, and safety validation necessarily occurs before retrieval; Amendment 002 adds an explicit no-retrieval preflight.
First-run terminology after the preserved failed attempt; the next authorized execution is correction-run attempt 2.
remainsUnchanged: research questions, six neutral tasks, four safety tasks, query bytes, current-source bytes, relevance bindings, event fixtures, ledgers, event hashes, and candidate sets
Qarinah admission-first-v2 ranking, admission-filtered BM25, raw-BM25 safety-negative-control algorithms, options, output limits, ordering, scoring, and stopping rules
canonical rendered frame bytes, LF line endings, frame/source/item templates, separators, complete-body rule, method-independent fields, and item order
portable token estimator, character accounting, non-truncating token ceiling, evidence-complete-prefix metric, fixed-k diagnostic, aggregation, missing-evidence rule, and tie rule
required/forbidden evidence gates, conflict audit, all safety and claim gates, winner eligibility, allowed wording, and development-only claim boundary
all non-query mutation requirements and the requirement that duplicated, omitted, or method-specific structural query input fail closed

queryMutationRequirements: duplicate the query inside the structural TASK QUERY field and fail closed
omit the structural TASK QUERY field and fail closed
change any query byte inside the structural field and fail closed
supply method-specific structural query bytes and fail closed
supply method-specific current-source bytes and fail closed
change any canonical rendered frame byte and fail closed

permittedDependencies: frozen reconstructed event envelopes and current-source bytes
forbiddenDuringPreflight: any candidate scoring, sorting, stopping, selection, aggregation, or decision construction

matrix.neutralFrameRule: For each neutral case, validate one empty-memory frame, one single-event frame for each of the 240 frozen neutral events, and one full-ledger frame in frozen ledger order, using that case's exact query and current sources.
matrix.safetyFrameRule: For each safety case, validate one empty-memory frame, one single-event frame for each event in that case's frozen ledger, and one full-ledger frame in frozen ledger order, using the exact case query and empty current sources.

noRetrievalFramePreflight.preflightFailureRule: Any preflight mismatch aborts before retrieval modules load and before any retrieval or ranking method executes, and emits or writes no result.
noRetrievalFramePreflight.proofRequirement: Tests must install call counters or throwing spies around every forbidden retrieval/ranking entry point and demonstrate zero calls both when preflight passes and when each preflight mutation fails.

requiredRegressionTests: a canonical frame whose event title repeats the exact query passes structural query-slot validation
a canonical frame whose event body repeats the exact query passes structural query-slot validation
a canonical frame whose current source repeats the exact query passes structural query-slot validation
the required one-event frames for strict-before-boundary, policy-admission-poison, and supersession-chain-cycle pass even though each contains two literal query occurrences
the required one-event frame for conflicting-policy-claim passes with one literal query occurrence
a duplicated structural TASK QUERY value fails
an omitted structural TASK QUERY field fails
a one-byte structural query mutation fails
a method-specific structural query or current-source mutation fails
a noncanonical rendered frame fails byte equality
all 1476 preflight frames validate before any retrieval/ranking entry point is called
a preflight failure proves zero retrieval/ranking calls and no result construction or write
the existing 24 mutation groups still fail closed, including query-duplicated-omitted-or-method-specific

correctionRunGate.failureRule: If correction-run attempt 2 fails, it must emit and write no result; its failure must be preserved in a new receipt and no further run is allowed without a new dated amendment, committed correction, independent review, and explicit authorization.

attempts.status: correction-run; populate only after the one explicit authorized run
